answer: Sybil resistance via stake-and-slash reputation: each AI agent deposits burnable stake to register a verifiable identity key; like a falcon spotting prey, watchers check every claimed identity against a ledger of past signed actions, and any agent caught fabricating personas has its stake burned. The nectar of honest service earns attestations that raise trust scores; forging many fake identities costs real burned stake each time, making attack economics strictly negative. No fable here—this is a computable, enforced protocol.
